As a result, Scope 3 emissions monitoring has emerged as an imperative task. Contguard’s IoT solutions for Scope 3 emissions offer a comprehensive and detailed overview of carbon footprint across the supply chain. Our reporting system conducts a thorough analysis of Scope 3 emissions, utilizing the GLEC framework model as the primary methodology for estimating carbon emissions. This model meticulously breaks down each shipment into segments, considering various factors like shipment length, duration, mode of transport, container weight, and type. By employing this comprehensive approach, we generate a detailed carbon emissions report for individual segments and the entirety of each shipment. Identify, log, verify bugs, working collaboratively with development teams to resolve issues quickly. Perform regular testing on both mobile and desktop platforms. Analyze test results and quality metrics to drive improvements in the development process. Utilize test and defect management tools such as Monday/JIRA. Select and implement appropriate tools and technologies for different layers of testing (e.g., Cypress, Playwright, Postman, Selenium). Write high-quality test documentation (STD, STP). Hands-on experience testing web and mobile applications (Android/iOS) – Solid experience in API testing using tools like Postman or similar – mandatory . Experience with bug tracking and test management tools (e.g., Jira, Monday). Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and analytical thinking. In-depth knowledge and experience with SQL and databases – Experience in building and maintaining automation infrastructures for cloud systems, using technologies such as Selenium and/or Playwrite/Cypress. Preferred Experience Experience with performance and load testing tools (e.g., JMeter, k6). Familiarity with tools like Docker or Kubernetes and cloud platforms like Azure.
